description: Header file defining Lua bindings for graphics settings and drawing functions, including color, shape, and transformation controls.

methods.name: background
methods.description: Sets the background color with various input options including RGB, grayscale, color name, or hex string.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets the fill color for shapes with options for RGB, grayscale, color name, or hex string.

methods.name: strokeWeight
methods.description: Sets the line width in pixels.

methods.name: stroke
methods.description: Sets the stroke color with options similar to fill.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Saves current style and transformation settings.

methods.name: rectMode
methods.description: Sets rectangle alignment mode (CENTER, CORNER, RADIUS).
